nota: Story sightings (sightings.mjs): a legendary Pokémon shows itself once per player. id picks the flight (hooh = flies across the sky with a rainbow trail; suicune = runs across water; lugia = a shadow swimming under you while surfing). mapa = the map (kanto), area = the area (or a list of areas) where it happens. Ho-Oh also needs a partner Pokémon out; Lugia needs you surfing.

lista.nome: Suicune on the water by Nugget Bridge and Route 25
Lugia's shadow under you while surfing the southern sea
